summary: UMC filed a Form 6-K disclosing ongoing share repurchases under a buyback program. As of May 11, 2026, cumulative repurchases reached 8,332,000 shares (0.07% of issued shares) for a total of NTD 391.9 million at an average price of NTD 94.06 per share, crossing the NTD 300 million threshold. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium was specified. The program is conducted by the issuer in the open market. This is a direct return of capital to shareholders via share buybacks, a cash-return event. What to watch: pace of future repurchases and any acceleration or suspension.
